title.rendered: Stewards Notifications - Canterbury Park (Fri Night) / Rosehill, Kembla & Wagga (Sat)

content.rendered:
Please note the following:

CANTERBURY PARK (Friday Night 27th November)
SURGERY
Race 8, No.7 - UNUSUAL PROSPECT: The John O’Shea/Tom Charlton stable reported the gelding has had a sustained condylar fracture to its off-fore fetlock since its last race start (20/7/26). The 6YO gelding has since barrier trialled on three occasions (Royal Randwick 7/10/25, Rosehill 19/10/26 and Royal Randwick 6/11/26).

IN FOAL
Race 8, No.16 - IT'S A WONDER: The Gerald Ryan/Sterling Alexiou stable confirmed the 6YO mare to be in foal.

LATE GEAR CHANGE
Race 3, No.12 - NOT INEVITABLE (NZ): Racing NSW Stewards have acceded to a late gear request from trainer John Sargent to add BLINKERS and a TONGUE TIE as he has used these on the 3YO filly in her most recent trial (17/11/26).

OVERWEIGHT
Race 2, No.7 - ROCKET GIRL: James McDonald permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted 55.5kg.

ROSEHILL GARDENS (Saturday 28th November)
